items.title: Independent Solution Design and Build
items.statement: Independently design and build a solution for a fictional public railway transportation organization as an individual assessment.
items.evidence_excerpt: you are expected to independently design and build a solution for a fictional public railway transportation organization. This is an individual assessment.

items.title: Requirements Discovery and Refinement

items.clarification_question: What mechanisms or processes should be used to document discovered requirements and assumptions?

items.evidence_excerpt: Use AI assistants and agents effectively throughout the development lifecycle.
items.clarification_question: Are there any specific logging or reporting requirements regarding how AI assistants were utilized?

items.title: User Experience Design
items.statement: Design appropriate and usable experiences for the people interacting with SmartRail applications.
items.clarification_question: Are there specific design systems, branding guidelines, or accessibility standards to follow?

items.title: Software Architecture Design
items.statement: Design a maintainable software architecture.
items.clarification_question: Are there preferred technology stacks or architectural patterns required for the backend, web, and mobile solutions?

items.title: Multi-Tier Solution Implementation
items.statement: Implement backend, web, and mobile solutions.
items.evidence_excerpt: Implement backend, web, and mobile solutions.

items.title: External System Integration
items.statement: Integrate with external systems.
items.clarification_question: What specific external systems need to be integrated, and what are their interface specifications?

items.title: Quality Assurance Practices
items.statement: Establish appropriate quality assurance practices.
items.clarification_question: What is the expected test coverage or specific testing frameworks to be used?

items.title: Non-Functional Engineering Considerations
items.statement: Consider security, reliability, accessibility, observability, and operational requirements in the solution.
items.evidence_excerpt: Consider security, reliability, accessibility, observability, and operational requirements.
items.clarification_question: What are the specific quantitative targets for reliability and security compliance?

items.title: Technical Decision Justification
items.statement: Make technical decisions and justify them.
items.evidence_excerpt: Make technical decisions and justify them.
items.clarification_question: In what format should technical decisions and justifications be documented?

items.title: Modernize Passenger Experience and Operations
items.statement: Provide a digital platform called SmartRail to modernize the passenger experience and improve visibility into railway operations.
items.evidence_excerpt: The organization wants to modernize the passenger experience and improve visibility into railway operations through a new digital platform called SmartRail.

items.title: Passenger Information Provision
items.statement: Provide passengers with accurate information about train services, routes, stations, upcoming trains, expected arrival and departure times, current train locations, and service disruptions.
items.evidence_excerpt: The platform should provide passengers with accurate information about: Train services. Routes. Stations. Upcoming trains. Expected arrival and departure times. Current train locations where appropriate. Service disruptions and changes.

items.title: Multi-User System Digital Capabilities
items.statement: Provide digital systems for passengers, train drivers and operational staff, railway stations, central railway operations, and external service providers.
items.evidence_excerpt: The organization also wants digital systems for: Passengers. Train drivers and operational staff. Railway stations. Central railway operations. External service providers.
items.clarification_question: Which of these multi-user systems are in-scope for implementation versus high-level design?

items.title: Multi-Application Architecture
items.statement: Deliver multiple applications and services rather than a single application as the complete solution.
items.evidence_excerpt: The complete solution will therefore contain multiple applications and services rather than being a single application.

items.title: Passenger Mobile Application
items.statement: Provide a mobile application that helps passengers understand the railway network and their journeys.
items.evidence_excerpt: Passengers should have access to a mobile application that helps them understand the railway network and their journeys.
items.clarification_question: Should the mobile application target iOS, Android, or both?

items.title: Passenger Journey Inquiry Support
items.statement: Investigate passenger-facing capabilities suggested by the brief, including train choice, next services, running status, location, stops, arrival estimates, disruptions, platform/timing changes and connections.
items.evidence_excerpt: A passenger may want to understand questions such as: Which train should I take? When is the next train? Is my train currently running on time? Where is the train now? Which stations will the train stop at? When will it reach my station? Are there service disruptions? Has the platform or departure time changed? What are the available connections from another station?

items.title: Intuitive Passenger Experience
items.statement: Provide an intuitive mobile application experience suitable for everyday commuters as well as occasional travelers.
items.evidence_excerpt: The passenger application should provide an intuitive experience suitable for everyday commuters as well as occasional travelers.

items.title: Determine Passenger Information and Functionality
items.statement: Determine what information and functionality would be valuable to passengers.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should determine what information and functionality would be valuable to passengers.
items.clarification_question: What specific user research or feature prioritization criteria should be applied to determine valuable passenger functionality?

items.title: Domain Model Representation
items.statement: Determine an appropriate domain model for representing the railway network and its operations.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should determine an appropriate domain model for representing the railway network and its operations.
items.clarification_question: What are the specific bounds and persistence expectations for the railway network domain model?

items.title: Live Train Journey Information
items.statement: Provide passengers with information about active train journeys including current progress.
items.evidence_excerpt: An important part of the system is providing passengers with information about active train journeys.

items.title: Live Information Mechanism
items.statement: Investigate and design the mechanism used to obtain, calculate, communicate, and update live information.
items.evidence_excerpt: The mechanism used to obtain, calculate, communicate, and update live information should be investigated and designed by you.
items.clarification_question: What are the source data feeds and latency requirements for live train information updates?

items.title: Digital Passenger-Information Displays
items.statement: Include digital passenger-information displays in the proposed railway-station experience, with concrete locations and information chosen during design.
items.evidence_excerpt: Railway stations should contain digital passenger-information displays.

items.title: Display Information Prioritization
items.statement: Investigate what information is most important for digital displays in different locations.
items.evidence_excerpt: However, you should investigate what information is most important in different locations.
items.clarification_question: What stakeholder requirements define the specific information needs for each display location type?

items.title: Display Connectivity and Resiliency
items.statement: Consider how displays receive updated information and how they behave when connectivity is unreliable.
items.evidence_excerpt: The solution should consider how these displays receive updated information and how they behave when connectivity is unreliable.
items.clarification_question: What fallback behavior or cached information must displays show during network outages?

items.title: Possible Interactive Station Terminal Experience
items.statement: Selected railway stations may include interactive public terminals that let passengers explore railway information without installing the mobile app; a terminal is not separately mandatory when the assessment allows a station-display prototype instead.
items.evidence_excerpt: selected railway stations may contain interactive public terminals. These terminals should allow passengers to explore railway information without requiring them to install the passenger mobile application.

items.title: Station Terminal Deployment
items.statement: If an interactive station terminal is chosen, design it for deployment on dedicated station devices.
items.evidence_excerpt: The terminal should be designed as an application suitable for deployment on dedicated station devices.

items.title: Station Terminal Technology and Interaction Model
items.statement: Determine the appropriate technology and interaction model for the station terminal application.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should determine the appropriate technology and interaction model.
items.clarification_question: What are the specific hardware constraints, accessibility standards, and preferred technology stacks for dedicated station devices?

items.title: Driver and Train Operator Application Access
items.statement: Provide train drivers and relevant operational personnel with access to a dedicated application supporting their operational responsibilities during a train journey.
items.evidence_excerpt: Train drivers or relevant train operational personnel should have access to a dedicated application. The application should support their operational responsibilities during a train journey.

items.title: Driver Application Scope and Permissions
items.statement: Investigate and define the information required by drivers and operators, and specify which information they should be permitted to update.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should investigate what information the driver or train operator would reasonably require and which information they should be permitted to update.
items.clarification_question: What are the regulatory and safety requirements governing what data a train operator is permitted to modify while on duty?

items.title: Railway Operations Platform
items.statement: Provide a web-based system for managing and overseeing railway operations that allows authorized users to understand what is currently happening across the railway network.
items.evidence_excerpt: The railway organization requires a web-based system for managing and overseeing railway operations. The operations platform should allow authorized users to understand what is currently happening across the railway network.

items.title: Operations Platform Roles and Responsibilities
items.statement: Identify appropriate user roles and responsibilities for the railway operations platform, supporting multiple access levels beyond a single administrator role.
items.evidence_excerpt: The users of this system should not simply be treated as a single Administrator role... You should identify appropriate user roles and responsibilities.
items.clarification_question: What is the complete organizational hierarchy and required permission matrix for each operational department?

items.title: Disruption Handling and Communication
items.statement: The system must provide an appropriate mechanism for handling disruptions and communicating relevant information to affected users.
items.evidence_excerpt: The system should provide an appropriate mechanism for handling disruptions and communicating relevant information to affected users.

items.title: Disruption Information Propagation
items.statement: Determine how disruption information propagates through the different applications.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should determine how disruption information propagates through the different applications.
items.clarification_question: How should disruption information propagate through the different applications?

items.title: External Catering Platform Integration
items.statement: SmartRail must integrate with the external catering platform.
items.evidence_excerpt: SmartRail must integrate with this external platform.

items.title: Catering Integration Data Provision
items.statement: Investigate which railway data the external catering platform needs, such as services, routes, stations, scheduled or estimated arrival times and service changes.
items.evidence_excerpt: The catering provider may require railway information such as: Train services. Train routes. Station information. Scheduled arrival times. Actual or estimated arrival times. Service changes.

items.title: Food Options Discovery
items.statement: Passengers using SmartRail must be able to discover available food options associated with their journey.
items.evidence_excerpt: Passengers using SmartRail should be able to discover available food options associated with their journey.

items.title: Food Ordering and Collection Arrangement
items.statement: Passengers must be able to select food and arrange to receive or collect the order at an appropriate point during the journey.
items.evidence_excerpt: A passenger should be able to select food and arrange to receive or collect the order at an appropriate point during the journey.

items.title: Investigate Catering Ordering and Fulfillment Workflow
items.statement: Investigate questions regarding the ordering and fulfillment workflow, including station support, order placement timing, modification rules, delay handling, missed collections, cancellations, payment processing ownership, menu ownership, availability changes, order association, and collection confirmation.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should investigate questions such as: Which stations support catering? When can an order be placed? How close to arrival can an order be modified? What happens if a train is delayed? What happens if the passenger misses the collection station? Can an order be cancelled? Who owns payment processing? Who owns the authoritative food menu? How are food availability changes communicated? How are orders associated with passengers and journeys? How is successful collection confirmed?
items.clarification_question: What are the specific operational rules and ownership boundaries for the catering ordering and fulfillment workflow?

items.title: User Event Notifications
items.statement: Determine which important events require notifications, which users receive them and how they are delivered; the brief leaves notification scope and mechanisms unspecified.
items.evidence_excerpt: Different users may need to receive information when important events occur.
items.clarification_question: What specific events trigger notifications, and through which channels must they be delivered?

items.title: Publicly Accessible Railway Information
items.statement: Some railway information may be accessible without authentication; determine the public-access boundary.
items.evidence_excerpt: Some railway information may be publicly accessible.

items.title: Passenger Account Authentication
items.statement: Some passenger functionality may require an account; determine which features require passenger authentication.
items.evidence_excerpt: Some passenger functionality may require an account.

items.title: Driver Application Authentication
items.statement: Driver applications must require authentication for operational users.
items.evidence_excerpt: Driver applications require authenticated operational users.

items.title: Railway Management Organizational Access
items.statement: Railway management functionality must require organizational access.
items.evidence_excerpt: Railway management functionality requires organizational access.

items.title: Role-Based Permissions
items.statement: Determine the different organizational permissions needed across operational roles; the brief gives role differentiation as an expected design consideration.
items.evidence_excerpt: Different organizational roles may require different permissions.

items.title: Identity and Authorization Model Definition
items.statement: Define an appropriate identity and authorization model covering the authentication and permission requirements.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should define an appropriate identity and authorization model.
items.clarification_question: What are the specific identity provider integrations and compliance requirements for the authorization model?

items.title: Application Suite Identification
items.statement: Consider five example application categories: passenger mobile, driver/operator, station terminal, station display and railway-operations web; do not interpret the illustrative list as five independently mandatory implementation deliverables.
items.evidence_excerpt: These may include: 1. Passenger Mobile Application 2. Driver / Operator Application 3. Station Terminal Application 4. Station Information Displays 5. Railway Operations Web Application
items.clarification_question: Are there any mandatory applications out of this list that must be delivered in the initial scope?

items.title: Design System and Language Strategy

items.evidence_excerpt: You should determine whether and how these applications share a common design language.
items.clarification_question: What are the technical constraints or target platforms for establishing a shared design system?

items.title: Passenger Experience in Busy Stations
items.statement: Design experiences that passengers can understand quickly while moving through a busy railway station.
items.evidence_excerpt: Special attention should be paid to designing experiences that passengers can understand quickly while moving through a busy railway station.
items.clarification_question: Are there specific accessibility or cognitive load guidelines that must be met for station environments?

items.title: Unreliable Network Environments
items.statement: Determine how relevant applications behave under conditions of unreliable network connectivity.
items.evidence_excerpt: You should determine how relevant applications behave under these conditions.
items.clarification_question: What specific behaviors or offline modes are required for applications during network outages?

items.evidence_excerpt: Security should be incorporated throughout the development lifecycle.

items.evidence_excerpt: The project should demonstrate a structured quality engineering approach.

items.clarification_question: What specific criteria or stakeholder requirements should be used to determine test value and justify the approach?

items.title: Avoid Unnecessary Full Railway Implementation
items.statement: Do not assume an individual assessment requires implementing every possible railway capability.
items.evidence_excerpt: You are **not expected to implement every possible railway capability**.

items.title: Coherent Smaller Solution Preferred
items.statement: Choose a smaller coherent and well-engineered solution rather than a broad set of incomplete features.
items.evidence_excerpt: A smaller, coherent, well-engineered solution is preferable to a large collection of incomplete features.
